Method of Attack: This spyware is delivered through malicious Microsoft Office documents and uses a shell script to steal personal data from web browsers, mail clients, and FTP servers. It also collects screenshots and videos, and captures clipboard data.
Attack Vector: Phishing emails and lure office documents

Method of Attack: Also known as Bladabindi, this remote agent Trojan is delivered through malicious Microsoft Office documents and uses a shell script to remotely control a victim’s device to log keystrokes, access the camera, steal credentials stored in browsers, upload/download files, manipulate the registry, and more.
Attack Vector: Phishing emails and lure office documents
